_comment: The expected suite spine for the FridgeLuck overhaul scorecard, from PLAN.md 'The scorecard (evals first)' on docs/spec-overhaul-20261011 (revision 2, 2026-10-11). Suites are run from evaluation/suites/<id>/ when their directory exists; suites listed here but not yet delivered report not-run with their owner named. platform: 'any' runs on any host; 'macos' suites run only on macOS and are imported from committed out/<id>/results.json (produced by an approved native CI run — the existing iOS CI targets, or a workflow Sam approves from ci/pending-workflows/) elsewhere.
